source_decision.authority: Taiwan Stock Exchange official OpenAPI / Government Open Data
source_decision.selection_reason: TWT48U_ALL is the existing verified official TWSE preannouncement source slice. The frozen H2 contract and current source authority permit it to be used as a partial source without claiming historical completeness. TWT49U is an optional licensed provider and is not required for the bounded J-B04 path.

source_cardinality.current_normalizer_behavior: More than one exact Code match raises binding_failed:ambiguous_exact_target_rows.
source_cardinality.future_rule: Retain fail-closed behavior. Do not select, merge, sort by date, or deduplicate multiple exact rows unless separately governed source-grain authority establishes a deterministic rule.

normalizer_semantics.target_binding: Exact TWSE market and exact security Code; company-name fallback prohibited.
normalizer_semantics.zero_blank_not_announced: Preserve as distinct typed states; do not normalize missing, blank, zero, 尚未公告, not-applicable, unavailable, or source-failed into one another.
normalizer_semantics.event_type: Classify only from explicit numeric classification inputs; unresolved classification fails closed.
normalizer_semantics.effective_date: Retain the source-supported event date only; do not infer that the event is effective because the date has passed.
normalizer_semantics.reference_price: No final official reference is supplied by this source stage; do not invent one or calculate one locally.
normalizer_semantics.revision_relation: Unresolved without official linkage; no inferred correction or supersession.
normalizer_semantics.no_row: no_evidence_in_covered_scope may describe the successfully retrieved current TWT48U_ALL source slice only; it does not mean no event occurred in the H3 historical comparison window.

prohibited_window_sources: lookback count converted to calendar dates
temporal_coverage.binding_rule: Only after H3 produces exactly one usable available baseline may orchestration pass its actual start_observation_date and end_observation_date to H2 assembly. The window is an interpretation binding, not proof that current TWT48U_ALL retrieval covered every historical event in that interval.

execution_contract.preview_and_authorization: The explicit request must include corporate_action_context and recent_performance for the same resolved TWSE target when H4 comparison is requested. The preview must display both operation/source authorities and bounded network estimates; owner authorization binds the full plan before either executes. H2 is never added because H3 or quote data alone was requested.
execution_contract.combined_network_budget: If both needs are explicitly selected, package authorization includes the existing H3 bound (at most three unique STOCK_DAY month GETs, retry zero) plus one TWT48U_ALL GET. Do not change H3 limits and do not make post-authorization calls.
execution_contract.dependency_binding: The approved plan contains a same-target H2 operation dependency on the H3 operation ID. Execution must complete H3 first and bind the exact H3 operation/artifact identity through the approved plan hash and contained execution bundle. H2 must not fetch H3 internally or accept an LLM-selected date window.
execution_contract.request_contract_assessment: Current execution-request v1 already supports the H2 capability without a public parameters object; H3 uses its existing v2 lookback parameter. Existing plan operation dependency_operation_ids can express the dependency, but planner ordering, dispatch dependency resolution, and exact H3 artifact binding require future A3 implementation support. No public MCP tool or H2 parameter is required.

exactly_one_available_baseline.behavior: Proceed H3 first; derive the actual comparison dates; perform the one bounded H2 request; normalize and bind H2; then invoke deterministic H4.
exactly_one_available_baseline.h4_invocation: Allowed only with schema-valid H2 and H3 evidence for the same exact target and a valid H3 window.

no_usable_available_baseline.behavior: Do not invent dates. Do not invoke H4 or issue an H2 request that cannot be assembled to the required H3 window. Preserve the H3 failure/partial evidence; mark H2 as dependency not attempted/blocked with a stable reason; return a partial/failed governed operation outcome and explicit no-comparison guard.
no_usable_available_baseline.raw_return: No ordinary comparison return is available when there is no usable baseline. If upstream H3 contains other raw values, they remain factual and must not be described as a valid H3 comparison or ordinary return.
no_usable_available_baseline.h4_artifact: Do not fabricate an H4 artifact without its required comparison window. Result/Audit/handoff must preserve the dependency failure and must not imply an H4 clearance.

multiple_or_ambiguous_available_baseline.behavior: Do not select one arbitrarily. Treat as unusable dependency, skip H2/H4 as above, and fail closed until H3 contract semantics identify exactly one available baseline.

preconditions: valid actual H3 start/end observation dates
non-empty H2 and H3 evidence references
h4_reconciliation.coverage_precedence: H4 first accumulates H2 window misalignment, source failure, binding failure, unsupported/not-applicable status, or incomplete declared scope; it also preserves uncovered subtypes. Any failure or uncovered subtype yields coverage_incomplete before effective-event reference states are considered.
h4_reconciliation.event_semantics: An in-window scheduled/preannouncement event produces unresolved-effective-timing failure and therefore coverage_incomplete. Source event facts may still be surfaced separately.
state_precedence: otherwise confirmed effective in-window event with missing official reference -> discontinuity_detected_reference_unavailable
otherwise confirmed effective in-window event with official reference evidence -> discontinuity_detected_reference_available
otherwise -> no_material_discontinuity_detected only if frozen complete relevant coverage rules are satisfied
h4_reconciliation.fixture_live_split: A1 allows deterministic governed fixtures for the two positive discontinuity states. Bounded-live H2 proves source/authorization/binding/normalization/stage/coverage/citation behavior and need not encounter an effective event. Real integrated behavior should exercise coverage_incomplete where applicable.

projection_wiring.h2_result_entry: H2 corporate_action_context_evidence.v1 is selected by the corporate_action_context operation lineage and projected by scripts/m8r_05c/result_builder.py into Result V3 target evidence.corporate_action_context.
projection_wiring.h3_result_entry: H3 recent_performance_evidence.v1 is selected by the recent_performance operation lineage and projected by scripts/m8r_05c/result_builder.py into Result V3 target evidence.recent_performance.
projection_wiring.h4_invocation: Not currently invoked by result_builder. It is a pure separate derivation in server/services/phase_h_discontinuity_safety.py; a governed integration stage must derive H4 after H2/H3 artifacts are validated and add its artifact/reference to the verified bundle inventory.
projection_wiring.h4_result_entry: scripts/m8r_05c/result_builder.py::_derived_h4_artifact reads at most one verified discontinuity_safety_evidence.v1 artifact and projects it into Result V3 target evidence.discontinuity_safety.
projection_wiring.raw_metric_vs_interpretation: Recent-performance values remain raw factual observations. The raw numeric fact and permission to interpret it as an ordinary economic return are separate facts. H4 ordinary_return_interpretation and interpretation_guard separately govern that permission; every non-normal H4 state blocks it.
projection_wiring.audit: scripts/m8r_05c/audit_package_builder.py records H2/H3 source attempts, evidence references, hashes, H2 requested_window, and H4 derivation/input references/state/guard. Future A3 must preserve component-level source provenance and dependency linkage using existing Audit V3 fields.
projection_wiring.ai_handoff: scripts/m8r_05c/markdown_renderer.py renders H2 coverage, H3 observation dates/values, and H4 comparison window, ordinary-return state and interpretation guard. Future integration must keep source-supported facts distinct from the H4 interpretation permission and visibly preserve dependency failures/caveats.
projection_wiring.schema_decision: Reuse current H2/H3/H4 evidence schemas, Result V3 and Audit V3. No demonstrated schema limitation requires a version change in A2.

failure_model.http_or_expected_transport_failure: source_failed; preserve source attempt; no false no-event; guard interpretation
failure_model.exact_target_absent: no_evidence_in_covered_scope for the retrieved current TWT48U_ALL slice only; H2 remains incomplete for the H3 historical interval
failure_model.missing_final_reference: Do not calculate locally; if effective event and timing are proven, H4 reference_unavailable; otherwise coverage_incomplete as dictated by frozen H4 rules.
failure_model.unexpected_executor_exception: Propagate as executor/operation failure; never downgrade programming or invariant errors into source_failed healthy evidence.
